phase_results.phase: Phase 2: Clarify - Workflow, Flags, Agents, And Governance
phase_results.summary: Accepted workflow/flag/agent/governance decisions: SPEC-010A supports only the mission-control workflow-contract family; enabled flags are registry-only; disabled_or_absent accepts registry keys plus reserved future flags FEATURE_TASK_CONTROL_PLANE and FEATURE_AGENT_RUNNER_SANDBOXES only; seed flag writes are config-owned seed operations, not admin mutations; product-line agent names derive from agent_prefix and agent_key with explicit facility/global shared support; unsafe governance defaults are first-intake-blocking unless explicitly overridden.

consensus.outcome: 2-of-3 majority accepted split validation with a narrow spec-owned reserved-absent future flag list.

phase_results.phase: Phase 2: Clarify - CLI Compatibility And Operator Evidence
phase_results.summary: Accepted CLI/evidence decisions: generic CLI uses --config/--db/--mode/--json/--allow-existing/operator-evidence; result envelope schema is product-line-seed-result-v1 with stable fields and exit codes; seed:mission-control delegates to generic --allow-existing behavior; docs live in generic and Mission Control runbooks plus spec quickstart; invalid-config fixtures cover distinct failure classes and enforce redacted no-mutation evidence.

rounds.outcome: Accepted wrapper delegation to generic --allow-existing behavior while preserving command name/core flags.
